description: Authorised doors only: x-door-key (a key issued by the office; the door receipt of plan v1.1 §2.6, signed by the issuing door) or x-hub-key (a GSC hub gate receipt). The hash goes on the Confidential Ledger; the receipt is kept and served by decision_id. Idempotent on decision_id.

actor_class.description: for which actor class (never a person)

decision_id.description: the id the issuing door gave the decision

object.description: what was cleared: a GTIN, an ISIN, a product id

records_read.description: the records read, each with its signature (or null where the record carries none)

rule.description: the rule object and version the decision was made under

signature.description: the issuing door's detached JWS (EdDSA) over the receipt's canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact) without signature, signature_check, ledger, receipt_url, page

hub_signature.description: the hub's detached JWS over the receipt (keys sorted, compact JSON), verified against the hub keyring

record.description: the gtinfetch answer the decision read: source_page, fetch_date, status, kid

receipt.description: a door receipt (dec_ id, x-door-key) or a hub receipt (gate_ id, x-hub-key)

name: write_receipt
title: Write receipt (authorised doors)
